review_description: I think that we received only 2 quotes from your suggestions within the time frame that I wanted to do something but the information we got was very helpful.I would like to thank you for your assistance.

John the salesman was great, he came on a Sunday and spent a lot of time with us. The quote was definitely not the cheapest but we felt comfortable with what was offered. They came to install within a few weeks which was great. The only bad thing has been with our Electricity provider, the solar panels are ready to go but we don't have a smart meter yet so can not reap the benefits yet.
